C.name: Predictive Coding（預測編碼）
C.responsibility: Prediction, observation, prediction-error measurement, uncertainty calibration and evidence-based model updates.

E.name: Deep Research（深度研究）
E.responsibility: Multi-source research, source provenance and quality, corroboration, counter-evidence, cited synthesis and cross-track research support.

F.name: Cyber Security & Defense
F.responsibility: Cross-track threat modeling, security controls, adversarial validation, vulnerability response and incident readiness.

G.name: Release, QA & Integration
G.responsibility: Cross-track integration sequencing, compatibility checks, regression gates, release evidence and rollback readiness.

H.name: Observability, Telemetry & Cost/Quota Governance
H.responsibility: Task and queue telemetry, Runner health, retry/failure metrics, cost provenance, quota thresholds and safe pause alerts.

I.name: Ecosystem, Connectors & Workflow Automation
I.responsibility: Authenticated external APIs, webhooks, notifications, state synchronization, idempotency and replay-safe event processing.

J.name: Self-Healing, Chaos & Continuity
J.responsibility: Bounded recovery, circuit breakers, safe degradation, checkpoints, backup/restore and controlled fault-injection exercises.

K.name: Knowledge Base, Docs & Governance Playbooks
K.responsibility: Architecture records, track boundaries, operator runbooks, handoff templates, decision logs and troubleshooting playbooks.

L.name: Multi-Node, Federation & Edge/Cluster Coordination
L.responsibility: Future opt-in node identity, capability-aware scheduling, leases, fencing, health checks and cross-node coordination.

M.name: Compliance, Policy Audit & Risk Governance
M.responsibility: Auditable actor/action records, policy evidence, risk register, scoped exceptions, expiry and retention controls.

N.name: Productization, Analytics & Growth/Ecosystem Ops
N.responsibility: Privacy-aware product metrics, adoption and quality analysis, feedback loops, onboarding and ecosystem operations.

O.name: Lifecycle, Deprecation & Legacy Retirement
O.responsibility: Deprecation inventory, migration windows, compatibility contracts, removal approvals and legacy maintenance reduction.

P.name: Governance, Ethics & Trust/Policy Evolution
P.responsibility: Autonomy levels, human approval thresholds, trust principles, policy evolution and cross-track priority arbitration.

policy: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; every change increments at least PATCH; breaking architecture increments MAJOR; additive capability increments MINOR. Cross-track changes require explicit owner review and compatibility evidence. Planned tracks do not imply shipped capability.
